title: The daily record: evidence before the headline
dek: IBIT holdings dated October 1, 2026, official software release records, and a visible account of what the source desk could not verify.
humanReview: Not individually reviewed by a human editor

briefs.headline: IBIT’s dated holdings record: October 1, 2026
paragraphs: The iShares Bitcoin Trust ETF holdings file reports 803,343.05410 BTC and 1,414,760,000.00 shares outstanding as of October 1, 2026. The source supplies a date, not an intraday timestamp.
This is an issuer-reported balance at a point in time. It is not a live price, independently audited total or measurement of money entering the fund. Holdings changes alone are not ETF flows.

For newcomers: read the “as of” date before comparing a number. For experienced readers: the source notebook preserves the exact decimal strings, parser version and retrieved-file hash for this observation.

briefs.headline: Bitcoin Core v31.1: the dated upstream record
paragraphs: The official Bitcoin Core repository’s latest-release endpoint returned v31.1, published July 8, 2026. This briefing records the endpoint result; it does not present the release as today’s announcement.

A version announcement describes software, not adoption across a network or a market forecast. Read the upstream notes and verification instructions before deciding whether an update suits your setup.
